name: LPSG mobile gallery UX — overlay 1 of 6
description: Makes the LPSG gallery honor a live runtime mobile/touch profile on wide Iceraven viewports, compacts mobile controls into More, converges scan progress to one live surface, and separates ZIP inclusion from explicit selection editing.
notes: Designed from the supplied 2026-09-20 scriptexts snapshot.
Preserves media discovery, filters, URL export, direct/ZIP downloads, cache, lightbox, video handling, pagination and post attribution.
Continuous scan progress is rendered only in the gallery progress surface; scan completion/cancel/error still use notifications.
Preselected media remains included in ZIP but yellow borders and checkboxes appear only while explicit selection mode is active.
Audit pass 1 fixed selection-mode entry when media is preselected and removed the remaining duplicate mobile scan-status surface.
Audit pass 2 fixed JS/CSS profile divergence by making isMobileLayout use the same live Android/iOS/touch/coarse-pointer/viewport profile and synchronizing it on resize/pointer changes.
Audit pass 3 found no remaining promised-scope gaps; node --check and static contract assertions passed.
